{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":12,"var":"Data/Size","code":"if (Size < 1) return 0;","note":"The raw fuzz input is accepted only when it contains at least one byte, and the last byte will be used as the link-layer type selector."},
{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"pkts","code":"pkts = pcap_open_dead(Data[Size-1], 0xFFFF);","note":"The final byte of the attacker-controlled input becomes the pcap_t linktype passed into the compiler pipeline."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"filter","code":"filter = malloc(Size); memcpy(filter, Data, Size); filter[Size-1] = 0;","note":"All remaining bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated filter string, so the attacker controls the exact BPF expression text."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":760,"var":"xbuf/filter string","code":"in_buffer = pcap__scan_string(xbuf ? xbuf : \"\", scanner);","note":"The crafted string is handed to the parser and converted into the internal compiler state for BPF generation."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":798,"var":"cstate.ic","code":"if (bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf) == -1) { ... }","note":"The parsed filter is optimized before code emission; the crash report identifies the failure in this optimization stage."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1905,"var":"opt_state","code":"if (setjmp(opt_state.top_ctx)) { opt_cleanup(&opt_state); return -1; }","note":"On optimizer error, control jumps into the cleanup path that frees optimization-state allocations."},
{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1925,"var":"opt_state","code":"opt_cleanup(&opt_state);","note":"The normal success path also calls the same cleanup routine after optimization finishes."},
{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_cleanup","line":2030,"var":"opt_state->blocks","code":"free((void *)opt_state->blocks);","note":"One of the optimizer-owned heap objects is freed during cleanup; the vulnerable bug is that the same cleanup can be reached twice for one compile, causing a double free of the same heap state."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
